title: Execute numeric memory records through the SYCL adapter
problem: SYCL stdout can succeed while numeric conversion or bounded output counts in accelerator memory are wrong.
example:
GPU queue: memcpy(input) -> memset(output) -> parallel_for(format_record)
-> memcpy(output) -> serialize(input, output); every stage waits and reports exceptions
design: Use a GPU queue and explicit device USM allocations. Wait on input copies, zeroing, parallel_for and output copies with wait_and_throw before freeing memory and serializing results.
tradeoffs: Runtime execution remains hardware-dependent; source-generation and host record tests validate structure but do not establish accelerator execution.
docs: The memory launcher formats on the selected backend and copies records to the host for byte-exact oracle comparison. Stdout control failure does not hide memory outcomes.
